name: bloodlink
description: BloodLink - ML-enhanced emergency blood donation and donor alert system.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix worker && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix worker" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build --prefix client && firebase deploy --only hosting --project bloodlink-18246
